'''Verls Belami''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Female]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was part of an Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as an archaeology trainer.
